keyFindings.description: The required check `test` completed as failure at the CI head 154d6cea. The failures are in the Go daemon only (packages/daemon/internal/daemon and internal/api, 306 lines of 'list this project's slotted issues: ... number of field descriptions must equal number of destinations, got 20 and 31'). This PR changes no Go code: main broke in #2273/#2289, and main fixed it in #2317 (baadccdc, 'fix(daemon): the slotted-issue read selects every issue column again'). The pull_request run tests the merge with main as of the push at 04:03Z, which does not have #2317, and a re-run keeps that same merge commit. Until a run of this code against a main that has #2317 is green, the code head is red, so no approval. The Dispatch code itself has no correctness finding open.

Spacing only: in a reply shown in a document decision's footer, a nested decision card's question gets the footer's paragraph top margin, because the footer rule's specificity (0,4,1) is higher than the content hole's first-child rule (0,4,0). Not a defect: no behaviour changes and no content is hidden. Recorded under 'Not proven / risk' in the PR body.

from tight list items, so the malformed class's li:has(>p:empty) selector does not hide a blank option, and an empty bullet shows. The malformed reason already names that option. Not a defect; recorded in the PR body.
